title: Water treatment
description: Ozone is the most effective and eco-friendly water treatment method. 95% of drinking water in Europe is treated with ozone. It does not form dangerous byproducts like chlorine.

pools-spa.title: Pools and spa
pools-spa.shortDesc: Clean water without chlorine smell or irritation
pools-spa.heroDesc: Crystal-clear water without chlorine smell. No eye or skin irritation even with long exposure.

content.intro1: Pool chlorination is a traditional disinfection method, but it has significant drawbacks: strong chlorine smell, eye and mucous membrane irritation, dry skin, hair and swimwear discoloration. Ozonation allows obtaining highest-quality water, practically eliminating these problems.
content.intro2: Ozone is the strongest oxidizer, exceeding chlorine in bactericidal action by 3000 times. It destroys bacteria, viruses, spores and protozoa, breaks down dense microalgae cell walls. The water gets a pleasant bluish tint.

benefits: More effective than chlorine against viruses

irritation.label: Irritation
irritation.description: Eye and skin irritation when swimming

regulation.label: Pool water standards:
regulation.text: Ozonation is recommended as a modern pool water disinfection method, allowing to reduce chlorine concentration to the minimum necessary level.

technology.title: Pool ozonation technology
technology.intro: Ozone is fed into circulating water after filtration, before returning to the pool basin. Recommended ozone dose for pools is 0.7–0.9 g/m³ of circulating water. Contact time in the contact tank is 6–7 minutes.
technology.note: When using ozone with chlorine, chlorine can be kept at 0.1 mg/L instead of the usual 0.7 mg/L. This practically eliminates skin and eye irritation.

pathogens.title: What ozone destroys in pool water
items: Microalgae: breaks down dense cell walls
Organic pollutants: sweat, urine, cosmetics, creams
pathogens.note: Especially important is that ozone is effective against Cryptosporidium — parasites causing diarrhea. They are extremely resistant to chlorine (requires 10,000 mg/L×min of chlorine for destruction), but vulnerable to ozone.

items.title: Visitor comfort
items.description: No chlorine smell, eye or skin irritation. Pleasant swimming.

items.title: Chemical savings
items.description: Chlorine consumption reduced by 5-7 times, reagent savings.

items.title: Regulatory compliance
items.description: Method recommended by sanitary regulations for pools.

spa.title: Features for SPA and jacuzzi
spa.intro: In SPA and jacuzzi, elevated water temperature (32-40°C) creates favorable conditions for bacterial growth, including Legionella. Ozonation is especially effective in these conditions:
items: Destruction of Legionella — dangerous pneumonia pathogen
Biofilm breakdown in pipelines and nozzles
Elimination of 'stale water' smell in rarely used jacuzzis
No irritation during long SPA procedures
